ValidationRule.description: Ensures NAS Agent adds a other root cause if the root cause field is entered as other.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.Name = "NAS General Support Case", ISPICKVAL(NAS_Root_Cause_Reason__c, "Other"), ISBLANK(NAS_Other_Root_Cause__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete Other Root Cause field when "Other" is selected for Root Cause Reason.
